item.title: AtomicView
item.description:
Mojo structSource

AtomicView

@memory_only
struct AtomicView[writable: Bool, T: ImplicitlyCopyable & Deinitable, origin: Origin[mut=origin.mut]] where Bool((eq UInt32, T)) if Bool((eq UInt32, T)) else Bool((eq Int32, T)) and not writable if not writable else origin.mut

Atomic-only access to borrowed target-local scalar storage.

Notes: Construct views through an owner. Raw construction is internal and requires aligned live storage accessed exclusively through atomics.

Parameters

  • writable (Bool): Whether updates are permitted.
  • T (ImplicitlyCopyable & Deinitable): UInt32 or Int32.
  • origin (Origin[mut=origin.mut]): Storage borrow retained by this view.

Implemented traits

AnyType, Copyable, Deinitable, Movable

Methods

Expand all   Collapse all

__init__

Moves the borrow without making it eligible for raw-byte transfer.

def __init__(out self, *, deinit move: Self)

Args:

  • move (Self): View whose storage identity and origin are preserved.
  • self (Self)

Returns:

Self

Borrows raw atomic storage under an explicit unsafe contract.

def __init__(out self, *, unsafe_pointer: Pointer[T, origin])

Args:

  • unsafe_pointer (Pointer[T, origin]): Naturally aligned target-local UInt32/Int32 storage, kept live and accessed only atomically while this view exists. Writable views require a mutable pointer origin.
  • self (Self)

Returns:

Self

__deinit__

Ends the borrow without destroying its storage.

def __deinit__(deinit self)

Notes: Explicit move/destruction keeps raw-byte resource and capture validation from treating borrowed host pointers as device values.

Args:

  • self (Self)

load

Loads the current scalar atomically.

def load[ordering: Ordering = Ordering.RELAXED](self) -> T

Parameters:

  • ordering (Ordering): Relaxed or acquire ordering.

Args:

  • self (Self)

Returns:

T: The observed value.

Constraints:

Ordering must be relaxed or acquire.

store

Stores a scalar atomically.

def store[ordering: Ordering = Ordering.RELAXED](self, value: T)

Parameters:

  • ordering (Ordering): Relaxed or release ordering.

Args:

  • self (Self)
  • value (T): Value to publish.

Constraints:

The view must allow updates; ordering is relaxed or release.

compare_exchange

Attempts one strong atomic comparison and replacement.

def compare_exchange[ordering: Ordering = Ordering.RELAXED](self, expected: T, desired: T) -> CompareExchangeResult[T]

Parameters:

  • ordering (Ordering): Success ordering; failure is always relaxed.

Args:

  • self (Self)
  • expected (T): Value to compare against.
  • desired (T): Value to store on a match.

Returns:

CompareExchangeResult[T]: Success and the value used by the comparison.

Constraints:

The view must allow updates and ordering must be a supported RMW order.

fetch_add

Adds with fixed-width wrapping arithmetic.

def fetch_add[ordering: Ordering = Ordering.RELAXED](self, delta: T) -> T

Parameters:

  • ordering (Ordering): Ordering of the read-modify-write operation.

Args:

  • self (Self)
  • delta (T): Amount to add.

Returns:

T: The value before this update.

Constraints:

The view must allow updates and ordering must be a supported RMW order.

fetch_sub

Subtracts with fixed-width wrapping arithmetic.

def fetch_sub[ordering: Ordering = Ordering.RELAXED](self, delta: T) -> T

Parameters:

  • ordering (Ordering): Ordering of the read-modify-write operation.

Args:

  • self (Self)
  • delta (T): Amount to subtract.

Returns:

T: The value before this update.

Constraints:

The view must allow updates and ordering must be a supported RMW order.

item.title: SyncView
item.description:
Mojo structSource

SyncView

@memory_only
struct SyncView[writable: Bool, T: Deinitable & Movable, origin: Origin[mut=origin.mut]] where not writable if not writable else origin.mut

Borrowed access capability sharing one reader/writer protection identity.

Notes: Raw construction is internal; the state and payload must share one stable protection identity and remain live until all views expire.

Parameters

  • writable (Bool): Whether exclusive acquisition is permitted.
  • T (Deinitable & Movable): Protected payload type.
  • origin (Origin[mut=origin.mut]): Storage borrow retained by this view and its guards.

Implemented traits

AnyType, Copyable, Deinitable, Movable

Methods

Expand all   Collapse all

__init__

Moves a capability without moving protected storage or its state.

def __init__(out self, *, deinit move: Self)

Args:

  • move (Self): Capability whose protection identity and origin are preserved.
  • self (Self)

Returns:

Self

Borrows target-local payload and its canonical protection domain.

def __init__(out self, *, unsafe_payload: Pointer[T, origin], unsafe_state: Pointer[UInt32, MutUntrackedOrigin])

Args:

  • unsafe_payload (Pointer[T, origin]): Payload accessed only through guards for this domain.
  • unsafe_state (Pointer[UInt32, MutUntrackedOrigin]): Aligned state initialized before workers start, shared by every overlapping view, and live for the entire borrow.
  • self (Self)

Returns:

Self

Constraints:

Writable views require a mutable payload origin.

__deinit__

Ends the borrow without releasing a guard or destroying storage.

def __deinit__(deinit self)

Notes: Explicit move/destruction prevents raw-byte resource/capture transfer, including transfer of aggregates containing this view.

Args:

  • self (Self)

try_read

Attempts shared access with at most one strong compare-exchange.

def try_read(self) -> TryAccess[_AccessGuard[False, T, origin]]

Args:

  • self (Self)

Returns:

TryAccess[_AccessGuard[False, T, origin]]: An immutable guard, or Busy for conflicting/changed/saturated state.

try_write

Attempts exclusive access with one strong compare-exchange.

def try_write(self) -> TryAccess[_AccessGuard[True, T, origin]]

Args:

  • self (Self)

Returns:

TryAccess[_AccessGuard[True, T, origin]]: A mutable guard, or Busy.

Constraints:

This view must permit writes.
